info.title: AI SiteMaker Runner API
info.description: Endpoints for launching, editing, and managing AI-generated marketing sites. All responses are JSON.

get.summary: List members of the current account

post.summary: Invite a user to the current account
Share a site with another account

get.summary: Return a thumbnail URL for a site
get.description: Builds a thumbnail URL (via configured screenshot service) for the latest preview/public URL. Pass `refresh=true` to bust caches.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: When true, appends a cache-busting timestamp to the thumbnail URL.

get.description: Records a lightweight metric for a site slug (view or cta) and returns a 1x1 response.

post.description: Public endpoint invoked by generated sites when visitors submit the on-page contact form. The payload is validated against the stored site config, then relayed via SES from an ai-sitemaker.com address.

400.description: Missing slug, fields, or contact email

get.description: Returns the latest lead submissions (contact + booking) stored for a site. Requires authentication and access to the site slug.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Site slug to fetch leads for

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous call

403.description: Caller does not have access to the slug

post.summary: Send a reply to a stored lead
post.description: Sends an email reply to the visitor's email, CCing the site owner, and appends the outbound message to the lead timeline.

post.summary: Update lead status or follow-up time
post.description: Marks a lead as open/responded/closed and optionally schedules the next follow-up reminder.

get.description: Public endpoint returning reviews that the owner has approved for on-site display.

post.description: Allows visitors (or the site owner) to submit a review/testimonial. Public submissions are stored as pending until approved.
Authenticated owners can change the status of a stored review (pending, approved, rejected).

get.description: Returns recent daily metrics (page views, leads, bookings) plus simple alerts for the requested site.

403.description: Caller does not have access to this site

post.description: Used by generated sites to record anonymous page_view, lead, or booking events. Accepts public requests.

Generates copy/layout with GPT-5.1, builds the base Vite template, and uploads the compiled /dist bundle to the preview bucket. Anonymous callers may launch once; authenticated users have an extra trial edit before a paid plan is required.

get.description: Returns the persisted site.json plus metadata describing the last deployment.

patch.summary: Apply edits to an existing site
patch.description: Loads the stored site.json, applies a structured patch or full replacement, rebuilds the Vite project, and redeploys to the existing preview prefix.

get.description: Returns the recent snapshot timestamps for a site (created automatically before each edit).

post.description: Replaces the current content/template JSON with a previously snapshotted version.
LLM-assisted editing flow. Sends the stored site + human instructions to GPT-5.1 to produce a SitePatch, applies it, and redeploys the preview slug.

202.description: Instruction accepted and site redeploy queued

get.description: Returns objects stored under the site's asset prefix.

post.description: Generates a pre-signed S3 PUT URL so clients can upload binary assets directly.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: File name returned by the list API. Do not include the full S3 prefix.

get.description: Returns a CDN URL with width/height/format parameters applied so the caller can fetch an optimized rendition.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: File name from the list API.

post.summary: Publish a draft update to the live prefix

201.description: Signup initiated. User must confirm via email.

post.summary: Create a user in Cognito + AI SiteMaker

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor token returned from a previous page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter accounts by partial email or account id match.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor token to fetch the next page (also emitted via the x-next-cursor header).

get.summary: List all site launches for an account

get.description: Returns a single payload containing revenue, plan mix, launch throughput, and queue depth metrics powering the operator dashboard (super-admin access only).

cache-control.description: Responses should not be cached; included for completeness.

post.description: Creates a subscription checkout session for the requested plan and returns the hosted Stripe URL.

post.summary: Create a Stripe customer portal session
Purchase and assign a managed domain
Create a Stripe checkout session for managed domain purchases

409.description: At least one domain already connected

post.summary: Mark a connected domain as verified
Attach a manual domain to a site
Automatically wire a managed domain to the site DNS records

get.summary: List domains + DNS instructions for a site

post.summary: Publish the latest preview to live hosting

get.summary: Usage snapshot for the authenticated account
Plan limits for the authenticated account
List domains for the authenticated account
Fetch a single domain for this account
List sites for the authenticated account

post.summary: Mark a site domain as primary

delete.summary: Detach a domain from a site

get.description: Authenticated owners can list pending/confirmed appointments for a site.

post.description: Returns an OAuth URL (Google/Outlook) or ICS subscription link (Apple) so the owner can sync appointments to their calendar.

SectionProps.description: Arbitrary props consumed by the section component.

componentId.description: One of the entries from SECTION_REGISTRY (e.g., hero-with-image, features-grid, testimonials-cards).

schemaMarkup.description: Optional JSON-LD string for schema.org markup.

sections.description: Single-page mode: ordered sections for the landing page. Provide either sections or pages.

pages.description: Multi-page mode: up to 5 pages, each with its own sections.

slug.description: Optional preferred slug. The system will append a counter if already taken.

regenerateImages.description: Set true to regenerate AI images; default is false to reuse existing assets.

instructions.description: Human-typed description of the desired changes. Example: "Move the gallery above testimonials and add a CTA button linking to /book."

assets.description: Optional manual asset context to include in the LLM prompt. Each entry should contain at least a url.

regenerateImages.description: Set true to regenerate AI images; default is false to reuse existing assets.

sourceUrl.description: Optional new reference site for context.

sendInvite.description: If false, suppresses the Cognito invite email.

temporaryPassword.description: Optional initial password. When provided with sendInvite=false it is set as a permanent password.
When supplied, sets a new permanent password in Cognito.

domain30d.description: Domain revenue collected in the trailing 30 days.

sectionId.description: Optional section id for the contact-form that triggered the submission

intent.description: Categorizes the submission (contact, booking, quote, etc.)
